title: The plan relies on the behavioral API-contract claim that every OpenAI-compatible endpoint returns a top-level
text: The plan relies on the behavioral API-contract claim that every OpenAI-compatible endpoint returns a top-level non-empty `model` field, but provides neither an authoritative reference nor repository evidence for that claim. REVIEW.md requires such runtime/API claims to be verifiable or explicitly marked unverified; cite the authoritative response schema and define the implementation fallback for incompatible providers.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 711dd7d, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
